nodes.name: .clomonitor.yml
nodes.summary: CLOMonitor configuration that points the CNCF project-health scanner at cert-manager's license scanning results so the license check passes.

nodes.name: .golangci.yaml
nodes.summary: golangci-lint v2 configuration enabling a large curated set of Go linters with exclusions for generated code and third-party paths, plus gci/gofmt import formatting ordered by cert-manager prefix.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses golangci-lint v2 schema with `linters.default: none`, explicitly opting in to each linter; gci sections group cert-manager imports after standard and default imports.

nodes.name: CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md
nodes.summary: Stub document redirecting readers to the cert-manager organisation Code of Conduct in the community repository.

nodes.name: CONTRIBUTING.md
nodes.summary: Stub document pointing contributors to the cert-manager website's contributing guide.

nodes.name: GOVERNANCE.md
nodes.summary: Stub document redirecting readers to the cert-manager organisation governance file in the community repository.

nodes.name: Makefile
nodes.summary: Auto-generated root Makefile that bootstraps the cert-manager build: sets host OS/arch and git version variables, defines the _bin/artifacts directories, a clean target, and includes the repository-specific and shared make modules.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses .SECONDEXPANSION and last-moment variable evaluation so module-provided dependency variables resolve late; shared logic lives in make/_shared and is cloned via klone.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Primary project README describing what cert-manager does, its supported issuers, documentation and installation pointers, development and contribution guidance, Go module compatibility caveats, and security reporting instructions.

nodes.name: RELEASE.md
nodes.summary: Release documentation covering the release schedule, links to the detailed release process, and the artifacts produced per release: container images, Helm chart, and binaries.

nodes.name: ROADMAP.md
nodes.summary: Minimal roadmap stub noting that the project roadmap has moved to the cert-manager community repository.

nodes.name: SECURITY.md
nodes.summary: Security policy stub directing vulnerability reporters to the cert-manager organisation security document.

nodes.name: SECURITY_CONTACTS.md
nodes.summary: Stub document pointing to the cert-manager organisation security contacts list used for private vulnerability reports.

nodes.name: USERS.md
nodes.summary: Stub document redirecting to the cert-manager organisation users list maintained in the community repository.

nodes.name: go.mod
nodes.summary: Go module definition for github.com/cert-manager/cert-manager on Go 1.25, pinning Kubernetes, controller-runtime, cloud provider SDKs, Vault, Venafi, and other dependencies required by the certificate issuance components.
nodes.languageNotes: Split into direct and indirect require blocks with `// indirect` markers; a comment reserves the top of the file for replace directives.

nodes.name: go.sum
nodes.summary: Generated Go checksum lock file recording module hashes for every direct and transitive dependency in the cert-manager module graph.
nodes.languageNotes: Generated by the Go toolchain; must not be hand-edited.

nodes.name: klone.yaml
nodes.summary: Klone manifest declaring which cert-manager makefile-modules (boilerplate, go, help, licenses, repository-base, tools, helm) are cloned into make/_shared and at which pinned commit, driving the root Makefile includes.
